tasks.subject: Task 1: Add Vitest + tsx, convert snapshot script to TS
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Install Vitest and tsx; convert `scripts/snapshot-colors.mjs` → `scripts/snapshot-colors.ts` with no behavior change. Establishes single-source-of-truth for sharing colorClassify between build script and runtime.

**Files:**
- Modify: `package.json` — add devDeps `vitest`, `@vitest/coverage-v8`, `tsx`; scripts `test`, `test:watch`; update `snapshot:colors` to `tsx scripts/snapshot-colors.ts`.
- Create: `vitest.config.ts` — minimal config with `@` alias.
- Modify (rename): `scripts/snapshot-colors.mjs` → `scripts/snapshot-colors.ts`; export `colorNameToSlug`, `ensureObject`, `ensureArray` for tests; gate `main()` with `isMain` check.
- Create: `scripts/snapshot-colors.smoke.test.ts` — sanity test for the three helpers.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `pnpm install` succeeds.
- [ ] `pnpm test` exits 0; smoke test passes.
- [ ] `pnpm snapshot:colors` regenerates `colors.snapshot.json` with row count matching pre-conversion version.
- [ ] `pnpm build` exits 0.

**Verify:** `pnpm install && pnpm test && pnpm build` → all exit 0.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["package.json", "vitest.config.ts", "scripts/snapshot-colors.ts", "scripts/snapshot-colors.smoke.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "pnpm install && pnpm test && pnpm build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["pnpm install succeeds", "pnpm test exits 0 with smoke test passing", "snapshot row count matches", "pnpm build exits 0"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Implement colorClassify.ts with full test coverage
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure functions for hue band, temperature, combo segment encode/decode. Foundational unit consumed by the snapshot script and the runtime hub.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/colors/utils/colorClassify.ts` — exports `Hue`, `Temperature`, `HUES`, `TEMPERATURES`, `hexToHSL`, `hexToHue`, `hexToTemperature`, `comboToParam`, `paramToSegment`.
- Create: `app/colors/utils/colorClassify.test.ts` — ≥30 hex inputs across every hue band and temperature bucket, plus boundary cases.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `hexToHue` returns one of 10 hue strings; brown carve-out, gray rules (l<8%, s<12%), 360° wraparound all correct.
- [ ] `hexToTemperature` returns warm/cool/neutral per spec rules.
- [ ] `paramToSegment` precedence: temp → combo → slug → null; strict hue-first combo; combo wins on slug collision.
- [ ] `pnpm test app/colors/utils/colorClassify.test.ts` exits 0.

**Verify:** `pnpm test app/colors/utils/colorClassify.test.ts`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/colors/utils/colorClassify.ts", "app/colors/utils/colorClassify.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "pnpm test app/colors/utils/colorClassify.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["hexToHue 10 hues with carve-outs", "hexToTemperature warm/cool/neutral", "paramToSegment precedence + strict combo", "all tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Extend snapshot script with enrichment + new outputs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Compute and persist `hue`, `temperature`, `related[]`, `complementary_slugs[]`, `prev_slug`, `next_slug` per row. Write `hub-index.json` and `categories.json`. Regenerate `public/sitemap.xml` to include detail and combo URLs.

**Files:**
- Modify: `types/supabase.ts` — extend `ColorPsychologyData` with six new fields.
- Modify: `scripts/snapshot-colors.ts` — add `enrichColors`, `computeRelated`, `resolveComplementarySlugs`, `computeAlphabeticalNeighbors`; new writes; build-time assertions.
- Create: `scripts/snapshot-colors.enrichment.test.ts` — 8-color fixture.
- Create (generated): `app/colors/data/hub-index.json`, `app/colors/data/categories.json`.
- Modify (generated): `public/sitemap.xml`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Every row has hue/temperature/related (≥3)/complementary_slugs (0-3)/prev_slug/next_slug.
- [ ] Exactly one row each has null prev_slug and null next_slug (alphabetical boundaries).
- [ ] hub-index.json row count == snapshot count; categories.json has no zero counts.
- [ ] sitemap.xml lists /colors + all temp + all combo + all detail URLs.
- [ ] Enrichment test passes; pnpm test and pnpm build both exit 0.

**Verify:** `pnpm snapshot:colors && pnpm test && pnpm build`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["types/supabase.ts", "scripts/snapshot-colors.ts", "scripts/snapshot-colors.enrichment.test.ts", "app/colors/data/colors.snapshot.json", "app/colors/data/hub-index.json", "app/colors/data/categories.json", "public/sitemap.xml"], "verifyCommand": "pnpm snapshot:colors && pnpm test && pnpm build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["all rows enriched", "one null prev_slug + one null next_slug", "hub-index.json row count matches snapshot", "categories.json no zero counts", "sitemap includes hub URLs + detail URLs", "enrichment test passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Modify RelatedColors.tsx to use precomputed fields
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace random shuffle and broken global-CSS-vars block with rendering from `related[]` and `complementary_slugs[]`. Each swatch uses real hex.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/colors/components/RelatedColors.tsx` — new props; render 3+3 mix; drop Math.random and style jsx global.
- Modify: `app/colors/utils/colorDataService.ts` — append `ColorSummary` + `getColorSummariesBySlugs(slugs)`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Accepts `relatedSlugs` + `complementarySlugs` props.
- [ ] Up to 3 Similar + up to 3 Complementary swatches with real hex backgrounds.
- [ ] No Math.random; no `<style jsx global>` block.
- [ ] Empty complementarySlugs hides the section.
- [ ] Dev check at /colors/coral-red shows visible swatches with no console errors.

**Verify:** `pnpm build && ! grep -q 'Math.random\|style jsx global' app/colors/components/RelatedColors.tsx`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/colors/components/RelatedColors.tsx", "app/colors/utils/colorDataService.ts"], "verifyCommand": "pnpm build && ! grep -q 'Math.random' app/colors/components/RelatedColors.tsx", "acceptanceCriteria": ["accepts new props", "renders up to 3+3 swatches", "no Math.random/style jsx global", "empty complementary hides section", "dev visual check passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Modify ColorNavigation.tsx to use precomputed prev/next
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace `Array.indexOf` walking with direct `prev_slug` / `next_slug` props. Disable buttons cleanly when null.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/colors/components/ColorNavigation.tsx` — new prop signature.
- Modify (interim): `app/colors/[color_name]/page.tsx` — update call sites for ColorNavigation and RelatedColors so build stays green before Task 7's full rename.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Props are `{currentColor, currentSlug, prevSlug, nextSlug}`.
- [ ] No indexOf; no neighbor recomputation in useState/useEffect.
- [ ] Prev/Next disabled when corresponding slug is null.
- [ ] Sticky scroll threshold (200px) preserved.
- [ ] Dev walk: first color shows Prev disabled; middle color shows both enabled.

**Verify:** `pnpm build && ! grep -q 'indexOf' app/colors/components/ColorNavigation.tsx`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/colors/components/ColorNavigation.tsx", "app/colors/[color_name]/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "pnpm build && ! grep -q 'indexOf' app/colors/components/ColorNavigation.tsx", "acceptanceCriteria": ["new prop signature", "no indexOf", "disabled at boundaries", "sticky threshold preserved", "dev walk confirms boundary disable"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Implement ColorsHub.tsx client component
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Unified hub component owning search input, chip filters, grid render, URL sync, lazy hub-index load. Used by /colors, /colors/<temp>, /colors/<hue>-<temp>.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/colors/components/ColorsHub.tsx`.
- Create: `app/colors/components/ColorCard.tsx` — extracted reusable card.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Accepts `{initialHue?, initialTemp?, serverRenderedCards}`.
- [ ] First render uses server-rendered cards (no shift).
- [ ] First interaction dynamic-imports `@/app/colors/data/hub-index.json`.
- [ ] 10 hue + 3 temp chips with active state.
- [ ] Chip clicks push canonical URL via `comboToParam`; hue-only stays on current URL.
- [ ] Search 120ms debounce; OR-match name/emotions/hex-prefix.
- [ ] Empty results show Clear search and (when filters active and count<5) Search across all colors.
- [ ] Manual walk: 'ff5' finds coral-red; chip cycle works; URL transitions correct.

**Verify:** `pnpm build` (component unused until Task 7/8 wire it).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/colors/components/ColorsHub.tsx", "app/colors/components/ColorCard.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "pnpm build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["props signature correct", "server render first; lazy import on interaction", "10 hue + 3 temp chips", "chip pushes canonical URL", "search debounce + OR match", "empty state CTAs"]}
```

**Files:**
- Modify (rename + rewrite): `app/colors/[color_name]/page.tsx` → `app/colors/[segment]/page.tsx`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Folder renamed; reads params.segment.
- [ ] generateStaticParams returns temp + combo + slug union.
- [ ] dynamicParams = false.
- [ ] paramToSegment branches: temp/combo → ColorsHub; slug → detail tree; null → notFound().
- [ ] generateMetadata branches by kind.
- [ ] out/colors/warm/, out/colors/red-warm/, out/colors/coral-red/ all have index.html after build.

**Verify:** `pnpm build && [ -f out/colors/warm/index.html ] && [ -f out/colors/red-warm/index.html ] && [ -f out/colors/coral-red/index.html ]`
